``` ::: ::: ## Step 3: Data Cleaning ::: {.cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} pdf = pdf.drop_duplicates() median_salary_from = pdf['SALARY_FROM'].median() median_salary_to = pdf['SALARY_TO'].median() pdf['SALARY_FROM'] = pdf['SALARY_FROM'].fillna(median_salary_from) pdf['SALARY_TO'] = pdf['SALARY_TO'].fillna(median_salary_to) pdf['POSTED'] = pd.to_datetime(pdf['POSTED'], errors='coerce') pdf['EXPIRED'] = pd.to_datetime(pdf['EXPIRED'], errors='coerce') print("Cleaning complete.") print(pdf.shape) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Cleaning complete.
